ABOUT YOUR VISIT

Privacy notice.

This notice describes the website code for Kelvin De Asis’s independent Ragsak Manila Café concept design. Last updated October 4, 2026.

Browsing this website

The site is a static landing page and photographed menu. It has no accounts, contact forms, checkout, online orders, or reservation service. Its code does not request your name, email address, phone number, or payment details.

Analytics, cookies, and embedded content

The website code includes no analytics or advertising scripts and sets no cookies or browser storage. Photos and fonts are served from the same website. Instagram, Facebook, maps, and videos are not embedded, so loading these pages does not itself contact those services.

This describes the site’s files. Hosting security features or analytics enabled separately by the person deploying the site may have their own data handling; this notice should be updated if the hosting configuration changes.

Cloud hosting

When the site is served through Cloudflare, Cloudflare processes network requests to deliver and protect the pages. Technical information can include an IP address and request or traffic information. This happens at the hosting layer even though this website has no visitor database or analytics code.

Read Cloudflare’s privacy policy for information about its handling of end-user data. Host-level logging, security settings, and retention are controlled by the hosting provider and deployment configuration; this website does not set a retention period for those records.

Phone, directions, and social links

A phone link asks your device to open its calling application. It does not submit a message or reservation through this site. If you call the café, the café and your telephone provider handle that communication.

Directions open Google Maps with the café’s street address. The site does not request or read your location. Google Maps may separately ask for your location after you open it.

Instagram, Facebook, and other external links take you to another service. These services have their own privacy practices and may use cookies or collect data when you visit them. External websites open in a new tab on desktop and in the same tab on mobile; you can use your browser to return.

Questions and changes

This concept website is not operated as the café’s official website. For questions about information in these pages or changes to this notice, contact Kelvin De Asis through the channel where this proposal was shared. Contact the café directly for menu and business enquiries.

If forms, analytics, embedded content, or reservations are added later, update this notice to describe the actual services, data collected, recipients, purpose, and applicable retention and contact arrangements.
